name: The Lovers
source:
You worked well on your legs today, pumped up your body over the years, but an active lifestyle makes you pay with energy. As soon as you reach home, you rush to bed from exhaustion in order to wake up a new you tomorrow. Only, will you be able to overcome yourself?

[Translated from [url=https://kornbyrg.itch.io/the-lovers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天你的双腿锻炼得很好，这些年来你的身体充满活力，但积极的生活方式会让你付出精力的代价。一回到家，你就因疲惫而冲上床睡觉，以便明天醒来时会是一个全新的自己。只是，你能战胜自己吗？

[译自[url=https://kornbyrg.itch.io/the-lovers]itch.io[/url]]
